svg.title: NinaPro DB2 original E1 source and sensor audit
svg.desc: Editable five-band scientific source audit. Content is based on the recorded S01 E1 MATLAB audit; blue and orange waveforms are explicitly schematic. Sensor markers show the forearm region and not electrode positions.

g.text: NINAPRO DB2: ORIGINAL E1 SOURCE AND SENSOR AUDIT
Paired sEMG and acceleration arrays · Source labels and repetitions · Descriptive audit only
Illustrative waveforms only; equal rows do not independently establish native sensor timing.
Original E1 MATLAB → aligned source fields → corrected annotation audit → traceable source evidence
